name: Puzzles — Floor-based
shortcutSummary: Number floors from bottom (1) to top. Create a table with floor numbers as rows and person/attribute as columns. Fill in the most definitive clues first.
conceptExplanation: Floor-based puzzles involve assigning people to floors of a building based on given conditions. You must determine who lives on which floor. These are common in Banking exams.

subtopics.name: Puzzles — Floor-based — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Floor-based puzzles involve assigning people to floors of a building based on given conditions. You must determine who lives on which floor. These are common in Banking exams.
shortcuts: Table Method: Create a floor×person table and fill systematically.
Definite Clues First: Start with clues that give exact floor numbers.
Above/Below Logic: "A lives above B" means A's floor number > B's floor number.
